decisions.reason: Having survived its first year in the firm’s core protective-footwear domain, this safety shoe line builds directly on existing design, certification, production, and sales knowledge, so management is more likely to refine the range than withdraw it.

The supportive insole still fits the firm’s footwear and fit-related know-how, but as a non-flagship insole in a now-rationalised portfolio it remains somewhat exposed if learning from market uptake points resources toward stronger adjacent offers.

The ergonomic safety shoe series is highly related to the firm’s established capabilities and was given strong product emphasis, making continued improvement and commercial scaling much more likely than exit.

As the stated flagship direction and a product tightly connected to the firm’s accumulated knowledge in work footwear, fit, and product development, the moulded insole is very unlikely to be dropped and is more likely to keep receiving development resources.
